messages.speaker: them
messages.text: ApnaBank helpline yahan se. Sir aap ki card expiry update nahi hui, payments decline ho rahi hain.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Haan actually do baar decline hua tha kal.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Exactly! Card number confirm kar dein aur jo PIN use karte ho woh bhi batao, hum nayi chip activate kar dete hain.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Bilkul, warna card permanent block ho jayega. Turant karo.
